p.scope-of-this-document: **Scope of this document.** The procedure every session ends with: confirm a good stopping state, rewrite `vibevm/vibespecs/WAL.xml`, overwrite `CONTINUE.md`, report.

p.also-defines-the-trigger-phrases: It also defines the trigger phrases that invoke the full wind-down explicitly.

p.THE-HOOK-TAKES-UNDER-TWO-MINUTES: For a well-scoped session the whole hook takes under two minutes; if it takes longer, the session did too much.

facts.HOOK-FIRES-IMPLICITLY: **Implicitly.** Every session that touched project state ends with at least steps 1–3. A session that ends without updating the WAL has partially broken the next session's context.
facts.HOOK-FIRES-EXPLICITLY: **Explicitly.** The user issues a wind-down phrase. Ship defaults: `END SESSION`, `WRAP UP`, `CHECKPOINT AND CLOSE`. Recognise the intent, not the exact wording — `FINISH SESSION` or `WRAP UP SESSION` must fire too. A project may add native-language twins in its agent instructions; the origin project of this flow runs a bilingual Russian/English set.

p.AN-EXPLICIT-WIND-DOWN-MEANS-A-FRESH-CONT: An explicit wind-down means the user is about to close the conversation and may continue from a fresh context — a new session, another machine, a different agent.

p.RUN-THE-FULL-HOOK-AS-A-HARD-CONTRACT: Run the full hook, steps 1–6, and treat it as a hard contract, not a courtesy: its purpose is to make session-boundary loss-of-context cheap.

stopping-state.title: 1. Confirm the work is in a good stopping state

facts.STOPPING-STATE-TESTS-STILL-PASS: Tests that were passing are still passing.
facts.STOPPING-STATE-GENERATED-FILES-EXIST: Files that were supposed to be generated exist.
facts.STOPPING-STATE-NO-HALF-APPLIED-REFACTORS: No half-applied refactors are left sitting in the working tree unless the user explicitly chose to pause mid-flight.

p.SAY-SO-RATHER-THAN-PAPER-OVER-A-BROKEN-S: If any of these fails, say so explicitly at the end of the session — do not silently paper over a broken state in the WAL.

rewrite.title: 2. Rewrite `vibevm/vibespecs/WAL.xml`

p.WAL-IS-A-CHECKPOINT-NOT-AN-APPEND-ONLY-L: The WAL is a checkpoint, not an append-only log.

p.REWRITE-THE-FILE-DO-NOT-PATCH-OR-APPEND: **Rewrite** the file — don't patch it, don't append to it.

p.an-append-only-wal-rots: An append-only WAL rots into an archive nobody reads; the rewritten file always describes *now*.

rewrite.fence:
# WAL — Project Continuation State _Updated: <ISO 8601 UTC — right now>_
## Current phase <what the project is actually doing at this moment>
## Constraints (do not violate without discussion) - <short line with a brief *why*, citing spec anchors where possible>
## Done - [x] <one-line collapsed summary of completed things>
## In progress - <what is partially done, with enough context to resume>
## Next <single next action>
## Known issues - <open problem we chose not to address right now>
## Session context <what to open / run / avoid at the start of next session>

facts.COLLAPSE-DONE-TO-ONE-LINE-EACH: A long "Done" section with implementation notes is a bug. Collapse each completed unit into a single line; the details live in commits.
facts.MOVE-BALLOONED-MATERIAL-INTO-A-SPEC: Anything that ballooned into multiple paragraphs probably belongs in a spec, not in the WAL. Move it out, leave a short pointer.

p.OVERWRITE-CONTINUE-WHOLESALE-ON-A-WIND-D: On an explicit wind-down — and at any session end that precedes a machine switch or a long gap — overwrite `CONTINUE.md` at the repository root, wholesale, with the cold-resume snapshot.

p.required-contents-pointer: The required contents (TL;DR, where work stands, blocker and unblocking action, next-steps recipe, non-obvious findings, repository map, standing decisions, recent commits, quick-start commands) are specified in [`cold-resume.xml`](cold-resume.xml#contract).

p.SURFACE-THE-CONTENT-AS-DRAFTS: Surface the proposed WAL and `CONTINUE.md` content to the user as *drafts*, plus any milestone commit.

p.DO-NOT-COMMIT-AUTOMATICALLY: Do not commit automatically — unless the project's standing instructions grant that autonomy, which many projects do for routine checkpoint commits.

facts.GROUP-COMMITS-BY-TOPIC: group commits by topic, never by time of edit: the WAL update and the snapshot are checkpoint commits, separate from code commits;
facts.PUSH-ONLY-UNDER-SANCTION: push only if the project's autonomy rules sanction pushing; when in doubt, stop at the commit and say so.

p.end-of-session-report-lead: Emit a short end-of-session report in the chat:

facts.REPORT-DECISIONS-AND-WHY: What decisions were made this session and why.
facts.REPORT-OPEN-REVIEW-MARKERS: Any open REVIEW markers the user should look at.
facts.REPORT-KNOWN-ISSUES-DISCOVERED: Any Known Issue that was discovered.

p.EXTEND-THE-REPORT-INTO-A-WIND-DOWN-TLDR: On an explicit wind-down, extend the report into a TL;DR of what the wind-down did: which files were written or updated, which commits were created, push status, and what the next session should pick up first.

p.one-screen-but-verifiable: Short enough to scan on one screen; detailed enough that the user can verify nothing was missed without opening the files.

p.THE-REPORT-IS-FOR-THE-HUMAN: The report is for the human's quick scan.

p.THE-WAL-IS-FOR-THE-NEXT-SESSIONS-AGENT: The WAL is for the next session's agent.

facts.NEVER-APPEND-TO-THE-WAL: Never append to the WAL. Rewrite it; the previous version lives in git history.
facts.NEVER-PAPER-OVER-A-BROKEN-STOPPING-STATE: Never paper over a broken stopping state — a red test suite recorded as green poisons every following session.
facts.NEVER-LEAVE-THE-UPDATED-LINE-UNTOUCHED: Never leave the `_Updated:` line untouched while editing the rest.
facts.NEVER-PUSH-ON-A-WIND-DOWN-WITHOUT-SANCTI: Never push on a wind-down unless the project's standing rules sanction it.
facts.NEVER-SKIP-THE-CONTINUE-OVERWRITE: Never skip the `CONTINUE.md` overwrite on an explicit wind-down — that is the half of the contract the cold reader depends on.

facts.SUM-WHEN-THE-HOOK-RUNS: The hook runs at every session end; a wind-down phrase (`END SESSION`, `WRAP UP`, `CHECKPOINT AND CLOSE`, project twins) invokes it in full.
facts.SUM-THE-STEPS-IN-ORDER: Confirm the stopping state honestly; rewrite the WAL; collapse history out of it; overwrite `CONTINUE.md`; report.
facts.SUM-PROPOSE-DRAFTS-BY-DEFAULT: Propose drafts by default; commit and push only under standing autonomy, in topic-grouped commits.
facts.SUM-UNDER-TWO-MINUTES: Under two minutes for a well-scoped session.
